clips.title: The story
paras: At Raven Hill Cemetery, the dead rise from their graves in western Duskwood. The burial ground once served nearby hamlets, but now undead, spiders, and grave robbers roam among the tombs.

Raven Hill Cemetery was once the burial ground for the settlements around the Dawning Wood. When dark sorceries fell upon the region, the dead began clawing out of their plots. Skeletons, ghouls, and shambling horrors now crowd the graveyard. Rotting abominations and giant spiders prowl among the tombs, while desperate grave robbers plunder ancestral crypts beyond the reach of local authorities. Raven Hill remains one of Duskwood's most dangerous places.
